The AnalystProjects scope already enforces is_active, which explains why client 4 receives AssignmentScopeIneligible. The seller role on project 1 uses a city filter instead of an active check.

The inactive project 3 witness is the real proof that production groups the OR correctly. If the filter compiler failed to group the OR, client 4 would be eligible and the test would fail.

The test name "common active" is misleading because the provider replaces the inherited ActiveProjects filter entirely. The role's AnalystProjects scope already enforces is_active, so client 4 is denied by the role filter rather than the common policy.
